intro: Helgrum the Swift sends you from Stonard to the Badlands outpost of Kargath, to speak with its head scout, Neeka Bloodscar. Word between Stonard and Kargath is often cut.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Badlands is harsh and lies close to the Alliance-held land of Loch Modan, so communication between Stonard and the Badlands outpost of Kargath is often cut.
Prove yourself, friend. Travel to the Badlands and speak with Neeka Bloodscar, head scout of the Kargath outpost. Speak with her, and then send her report back to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Helgrum wants a report, eh? I sent an outrunner to Stonard not three days past. Did he fail his mission? If Stonard does not have my report, then it appears he did fail.
Let's hope the next runner I send has more skill, or more luck.
